offering_description.value: Orion leases office buildings and specialized properties to businesses and government agencies. It owns and manages the buildings and leases most of them to a single tenant under net leases.

primary_services.value: office property leasing; specialized commercial property leasing

customer_segment.value: B2B: corporate office tenants, healthcare providers, and research organizations; B2G: government agencies that lease office or specialized space

end_markets.value: corporate offices; government facilities; healthcare facilities; research and development facilities

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: rent and applicable property expense reimbursements under commercial leases

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: acquires and manages commercial properties leased to businesses and government agencies

geography_served.value: US national: suburban markets across multiple U.S. regions

specialization.value: related lines: traditional offices and specialized properties such as medical, research, and government facilities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house leasing team working with prospective and existing tenants; agents / brokers: commercial real estate brokers that market available space and represent tenants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: local zoning and building codes, environmental requirements, and federal REIT tax rules

notes: The current mix of traditional office and specialized properties is uncertain.
